replies.body:
Addressed in 82411d81afd11c69c2f9e57e26553e122ac8c23b.

Analysis: At frozen build.gradle.kts lines 43-51, mkdirs and JFlex --nobak do not remove obsolete generated files. The source set includes the whole output directory and SqlQuery no longer defines createWithSummary. Checked recursive deletion now precedes generation. Tests with the obsolete factory-calling source and a nested stale file verify removal, current sanitizer creation, successful compilation, and configuration-cache reuse.

Upsides: Prevents incremental-checkout compilation failures and explicitly reports cleanup failures instead of compiling stale sources.

Downsides: Regeneration performs a recursive deletion limited to the dedicated JFlex output directory.
